verification.rule: verify all five durable teammates are running or inactive before creating research tasks; every new campaign or research round must delegate model-facing work to the five teammates

campaign_protocol.rule: Every new campaign or research round MUST delegate model-facing work to the five DSH teammates; a Lead-only campaign is a protocol violation.

reader_policy.default: Reader is required when the Web Gateway discovery map has at least 4 cited sources, when the map explicitly requires Reader, or when it records unread/paywalled full-text sources; otherwise Reader is recommended.
reader_policy.boundary: Reader extracts structured evidence only; it never generates, ranks or promotes a candidate.

delegation: list_agents and spawn_teammate any missing member from the plan prompts
create one shared task per delegated role on the task board
send_message with a self-contained task (role boundaries, inputs, output contract)
wait for teammate outputs; deterministic services stay with the Lead
record task ids and teammate outputs under the campaign team directory
campaign_protocol.lead_boundary: The Lead may execute cycle/search/eval/campaign recording only on teammate outputs, or for explicitly labeled mechanical re-runs; the Lead must not generate or interpret candidates alone.
campaign_protocol.violation: A campaign without teammate evidence is invalid as research and must not be presented as a research result.

external_evidence_policy.default: Every new alpha-campaign-v2 campaign must have a Web Gateway cited discovery step before PathFinder; if no new evidence exists, record explicit reuse/no-new-evidence rather than silently skipping
external_evidence_policy.boundary: External evidence may motivate hypotheses but never overrides deterministic Gate/FDR; raw HTML is not forwarded

ml_planner_policy.default: Every new alpha-campaign-v2 campaign must have an ML Planner decision: a pre-registered plan or an explicit falsifiable skip reason; ML experiments need not run every campaign, but silent omission is a protocol violation
ml_planner_policy.signal: PathFinder must set ml_branch.request_ml_planner with an explicit reason; false is allowed only with a concrete falsifiable reason
ml_planner_policy.boundary: ML remains research evidence; it cannot override the deterministic Gate or unlock holdout

change_control.rule: Any agent-team logic optimization must be codified in roles/behaviors/enforcement/tests/docs in the same change; conversation-only changes are not binding.

full_team_delegation.definition: Every campaign must have its own completed model-facing task ids and campaign-scoped outputs. A task id reused from another campaign, a shared PathFinder/FactorBuilder output, or a pre-registration that pre-registers multiple independent campaigns is a protocol violation.
full_team_delegation.enforcement: protocol_audit is binding; new campaigns default full_team_protocol=true and must pass audit before preflight opens or resumes them.

task_board_policy.purpose: ephemeral coordination only; the task board is not research evidence and is not a provenance store
task_board_policy.cleanup: after the campaign outputs are recorded under the campaign team directory and campaign-audit passes, delete that campaign's completed task ids; keep only pending/in_progress tasks
task_board_policy.invariant: deleting task-board entries must never delete campaign team manifests, frozen pre-registrations, factor artifacts or result files; those remain the durable record
task_board_policy.limit: the task board is a hard-capped coordination surface; stale completed tasks must not be retained

research_evidence_policy.note: Gate pass is not promotion; long-short evidence is diagnostic and cannot veto a long-only candidate by itself.

research_memory_policy.legacy: campaigns created before required_from are grandfathered; they are not treated as memory-valid
research_memory_policy.boundary: The context must carry source hashes and every failed/unverified validation; an LLM may compress narrative but cannot change facts.

steps: use `list_agents` to inspect current DSH teammates
spawn every missing member with `spawn_teammate` and the prompt below
use `list_agents` again and verify all members are running or inactive
run `python -m factor_lab alpha team verify` as the static roster check
before every campaign/round, create shared tasks for the five teammates and delegate model-facing work
record task ids and teammate outputs under output/factor_lab/alpha/campaigns/<campaign_id>/team/
start research with `python -m factor_lab alpha campaign ...` or an L0 cycle on teammate outputs
